cir_ast.preprocessing: stereo mean to mono; scipy polyphase resample; no loudness normalization

clap_music.preprocessing: stereo mean to mono; scipy polyphase resample; no loudness normalization

statistics.bootstrap_method: crossed preset-family × MIDI-performance cluster bootstrap; anchored distance pairs use distinct original identities sampled in proportion to bootstrap multiplicity products; variance shares use the full crossed resampled grid; identical cluster draws and sampled pair positions across arms
statistics.bootstrap_combination_sampling: Monte Carlo estimate of the exhaustive 2x2 statistic; preset and MIDI pairs are sampled from their resampled clusters conditioned on distinct original identities, yielding multiplicity-product pair weights; full-cohort point summaries are exhaustive
statistics.paired_effect_estimator: difference between observed exhaustive full-cohort point estimates; paired bootstrap distribution supplies the confidence interval only
statistics.ratio_rule: undefined if different-preset same-MIDI cosine distance is at or below the near-zero tolerance
statistics.preset_dominant_rule: different-preset same-MIDI distance exceeds same-preset different-MIDI distance by more than tie tolerance
statistics.confidence_interval: percentile 95% interval over crossed cluster resamples; intervals do not treat anchor observations as independent

difficult_preset_stratum.reason: Existing source-family metadata maps each of the 129 presets to a singleton family and contains no independent difficulty label; no model-specific distance or retrieval score was used to select a subset.
